description: Land Acquisition - Akarahediya, Laggala D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act for the Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their locations, extents, claimants, and possession details. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns government acquisition of land for public purposes, including property descriptions, ownership claims, and compensation procedures.
